slides.ocr_text: This slide introduces SHAP values. The left text block defines local explanation. The right figure shows how positive and negative feature contributions move a model prediction from a base value to the final output. The bottom caption says SHAP values attribute prediction differences to individual features.
slides.neighbor_slide_text: Previous slide: feature importance gives global ranking. Next slide: force plots visualize local SHAP explanations for one prediction.

aois.name: Whole slide
aois.text: This slide introduces SHAP values and contrasts the definition, figure, and caption.

aois.name: Title
aois.text: SHAP Values for Local Model Explanation

aois.name: Left text block
aois.text: SHAP explains a single model prediction by assigning each feature a contribution value.

aois.name: Right figure
aois.text: The figure shows positive and negative feature contributions pushing the prediction away from the base value.

aois.name: Bottom caption
aois.text: Caption: SHAP values attribute the difference between the expected prediction and the final prediction to each feature.

aois.name: Bottom formula
aois.text: f(x) = E[f(x)] + sum of SHAP feature contributions.
